description: This Swift source file defines a NotificationManager struct responsible for managing and sending user notifications on macOS. It handles permission requests, sets notification content including sound and interruption levels, and queues notifications for delivery.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing user notifications, including permission handling, content configuration, and sending notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a user notification with specified title, body, optional sound, and optional priority, handling permission checks and entitlement requirements.
